findings.explanation: You would have to wait up to 90 days after invoicing before receiving payment, which is considerably longer than the customary 30‑day term.
You will only be paid within 90 days of invoicing, which delays cash flow and increases financial risk.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hi,

- The relevant clause states "Invoices are payable Net 90." This would require payment up to 90 days after invoicing, which is longer than the usual 30‑day term. I propose changing the clause to read "Invoices are payable Net 30."
- The relevant clause states "Payment period: Net 90". This would mean payment could be delayed up to 90 days, affecting cash flow. I suggest revising it to "Payment period: Net 30".

Thanks for your attention. I look forward to finalising the agreement.
